description: Shared Renovate rules for repositories that run gh-aw workflows. Extend with github>going-dev/.github//renovate/gh-aw.

packageRules.description: Everything gh-aw generates is output, not input. gh aw upgrade and compile rewrite these from the CLI's own version, so a bump landed here is reverted by the next compile run. Move them by bumping github/gh-aw, which sets the gh-aw version in the gh-aw-compile caller.
gh-aw publishes near-daily releases; batch to a weekly cadence to cut PR noise

customManagers.description: Versions in workflow files marked with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above, such as the gh-aw version in a repository's gh-aw-compile caller and its own validate.yml. The value may be quoted.
